sources.snippet: Llama-3.1-8B-PROSPER-baseline PROSPER / MaxEntBW baseline, reproduced under the NBPO training setup. It selects each prompt's worst objective rather than bargaining across all four, and loses individual rationality on three of them. Trained from meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which is also the reference policy (\mu) and the initialisation (\pi_0). Four objectives are scored on UltraFeedback ...

sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B brings powerful performance in a smaller, more efficient package. With improved multilingual support, tool use, and a 128K context length, it enables sophisticated use cases like interactive agents and compact coding assistants while remaining lightweight and accessible.
